string.name: agent_change_before_first_message
string.value: You can change the Agent preset before sending the first message.

string.name: agent_locked_after_start
string.value: DSH locks the Agent preset after the session starts. Models and reasoning effort remain selectable when supported.

string.name: agent_preset_locked
string.value: Agent preset is locked and cannot be changed

string.name: archive_session_warning
string.value: The chat disappears from the list; its history stays on your computer.

string.name: attachment_file_too_large
string.value: The file is larger than %s and cannot be uploaded as a message attachment.

string.name: attachment_image_too_large
string.value: The image is larger than %s and cannot be inlined. Compress or crop it first, or send it with “Send file”.

string.name: attachment_read_failed
string.value: Could not read the selected file. Try another one.

string.name: attachment_unavailable
string.value: Image unavailable (it may have been cleaned up)

string.name: author_value
string.value:
Original author Github@Hakunm
Maintained here by Github@westanke

string.name: binary_file
string.value: Binary file — cannot open as text

string.name: busy_send_mode_queue_desc
string.value: Handle it after the current turn finishes

string.name: busy_send_mode_steer_desc
string.value: Send it as additional guidance into the running turn

string.name: busy_send_mode_subtitle
string.value: What Enter or the send key does while a run is in progress. The other behaviour is always available: press Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on a hardware keyboard, or tap the steer button next to it.

string.name: chat_write_required
string.value: This device lacks chat.write — cannot create a chat

string.name: clipboard_empty
string.value: Can't read the clipboard - long-press the field to paste

string.name: connect_subtitle
string.value: Connect to a DSH workspace with remote access enabled

string.name: credentials_expired
string.value: Credential expired — pair again or re-import the configuration

string.name: custom_provider_subtitle
string.value: Create the same custom model route supported by DSH WebUI.

string.name: etag_conflict
string.value: The file changed elsewhere — refresh before editing

string.name: fork_session_warning
string.value: A copy is created on your computer; the original is untouched.

string.name: full_access_ack
string.value: I reviewed the command and understand the full-access risk

string.name: full_access_warning
string.value: This operation will run outside the DSH sandbox and may access server files, the network, and processes. Review the command above first. The App does not offer permanent approval.

string.name: gen_ui_debug_desc
string.value: When on, each assistant message gets a small grey line explaining why a card did not render as a component.

string.name: gen_ui_debug_footnote
string.value: Tap the grey line to expand it, long-press to copy. If you see a warning sign or “fences seen but not recognised”, send a screenshot.

string.name: http_warning
string.value: HTTP sends the device token and content in clear text. Use it only on a trusted network, VPN, or tunnel.

string.name: import_entry_hint
string.value: Generate the text on your computer, send it to yourself, then paste it here

string.name: import_explanation
string.value: Built for when you are already away and cannot see the computer screen: generate a short configuration text on the computer (send it to yourself or keep it in a private note), then paste it here. No QR code and no camera needed.

string.name: import_hint
string.value: Paste the configuration text starting with DSH1:

string.name: import_invalid
string.value: This configuration text is not recognized — check that the copy is complete

string.name: import_security_note
string.value: This text is effectively a key. Send it only to yourself — never to a group chat or a public place.

string.name: inherited_model_ids_hint
string.value: Currently inherited from the DSH model catalog; leaving it unchanged will not create a fixed override

string.name: keep_existing_secret
string.value: Leave blank to keep the saved key

string.name: link_anchor_unsupported
string.value: In-page anchors are not supported yet

string.name: link_open_failed
string.value: No app can open this link

string.name: link_relative_path
string.value: This is a relative path, so the file cannot be located. Open it from the session files list instead

string.name: link_scheme_unsupported
string.value: This kind of link cannot be opened yet

string.name: manage_workspaces_subtitle
string.value: Manage the workspaces registered in DSH WebUI that this device may access.

string.name: manual_pairing_hint
string.value: The pairing code must be generated on the computer, so this suits the case where you are still next to it.

string.name: message_hint
string.value: Describe what you want to build

string.name: model_ids_hint
string.value: Enter one model ID per line

string.name: model_ids_required_hint
string.value: Enter one model ID per line; at least one is required

string.name: models_subtitle
string.value: Configure model providers, credentials, and available models

string.name: no_hosts_yet
string.value: No computer saved yet. Add one below.

string.name: no_sessions_yet
string.value: No chat yet. Create one from the top right.

string.name: permission_full_access_ack
string.value: I understand that full access bypasses workspace limits and approvals

string.name: permission_full_access_warning
string.value: Full access disables the DSH sandbox and per-action approvals. The Agent can access files, network, and processes on the server. Enable it only for a task you trust.

string.name: platform_self_check_desc
string.value: Results of three synchronous round-trips: preferences, encryption, and the host store. The platform layer is the only part that cannot be unit-tested offline, so it really runs on the device.

string.name: plugins_empty
string.value: No plugin is installed in this profile.

string.name: plugins_permission_required
string.value: This device does not have the settings.read scope, so the plugin inventory cannot be shown. Enable settings read for this device in the DSH WebUI workspace settings.

string.name: plugins_problem_banner
string.value: %d plugin(s) need attention: some are declared but missing (their features will not work), others are installed but not loaded.

string.name: plugins_restart_hint
string.value: This writes DSH's startup bundle list, so it takes effect after DSH restarts. Until then the plugin keeps running in its previous state.

string.name: plugins_subtitle
string.value: See which plugins are installed in the current profile and which ones are loaded.

string.name: plugins_toggle_confirm_disable
string.value: Disabling removes whatever this plugin provides. The change is written to the plugin list on your computer, with a backup of the original file. It takes effect after DSH restarts.

string.name: plugins_toggle_confirm_enable
string.value: Enabling restores whatever this plugin provides. The change is written to the plugin list on your computer, with a backup of the original file. It takes effect after DSH restarts.

string.name: plugins_toggle_missing_locked
string.value: Declared for loading but not found on the computer. Install it there first.

string.name: plugins_toggle_not_installed_locked
string.value: This package is not installed on the computer, so it cannot be toggled.

string.name: plugins_toggle_official_locked
string.value: An official DSH plugin shipped with the runtime; it cannot be toggled.

string.name: plugins_unavailable_generic
string.value: The server cannot provide the plugin inventory right now (%s).

string.name: plugins_unavailable_manifest_unreadable
string.value: The server cannot read the plugin manifest: package.json may be corrupt, missing, or unreadable.

string.name: plugins_unavailable_profile_unknown
string.value: The server cannot tell which plugin profile is in use, so the inventory is unavailable. Make sure DSH is started as dsh web or dsh --profile web.

string.name: preview_skipped_hint_download
string.value: Download it and open it in another app.

string.name: preview_skipped_too_large
string.value: File is %s — over the %s limit, so the preview was skipped.

string.name: provider_id_hint
string.value: Start with a lowercase letter; digits and hyphens are allowed, for example acme-gateway

string.name: provider_secret_note
string.value: API keys are written only to the server credential store. The app cannot read or display saved keys.

string.name: rate_limited
string.value: Too many requests — try again later

string.name: reason_clipboard
string.value: Paste the connection configuration text generated on your computer

string.name: reason_internet
string.value: Connect to the DSH workspace service on your computer

string.name: reason_network_info
string.value: Determine the current network type to pick the fastest endpoint

string.name: remove_computer_warning
string.value: Its addresses and device credential will be deleted. You will need to pair or import the configuration again.

string.name: remove_workspace_warning
string.value: \"%s\" is only removed from the DSH WebUI workspace list. The server directory, files, and chat logs are kept.

string.name: scroll_select_hint
string.value: Double-tap to copy the whole message

string.name: session_configuration_subtitle
string.value: View or change this session's Agent, model, and reasoning effort

string.name: session_file_binary
string.value: This file is not UTF-8 text, so it cannot be previewed.

string.name: session_file_directory
string.value: This is a directory. The Files tab has been switched to it, so you can browse the contents there.

string.name: session_file_files_hint
string.value: Full content and editing are in the Files tab.

string.name: session_file_open_directory
string.value: Open this directory in the Files tab

string.name: session_file_outside_roots
string.value: This path is not inside any authorized root on the computer, or it is not a regular file, so the server refuses to resolve it and the phone cannot open it. Ask the agent to put it inside an authorized workspace directory.

string.name: session_file_partial
string.value: Only files from the loaded part of the history are shown. Load older messages to see more.

string.name: session_file_pdf_unsupported
string.value: PDFs cannot be rendered inline on this platform (ArkUI has no PDF component). The bytes are available; see the full content in the Files tab.

string.name: session_file_plugin_too_old
string.value: The dsh-remote-bridge plugin on the server (formerly dsh-workspace) is too old and does not provide the path-resolving endpoint yet. Upgrade it to 2.0.4 or newer, then restart DSH.

string.name: session_file_too_large
string.value: The file is larger than 2 MiB, so it is not previewed in this panel.

string.name: session_file_truncated
string.value: Only the beginning is previewed here; the full content is in the Files tab.

string.name: session_files_empty
string.value: This session has not mentioned any openable file path yet.

string.name: session_files_subtitle
string.value: Files this session mentioned and that can be located. Only server-side absolute paths are listed; paths inside commands and relative paths are not parsed — better to list too few than to guess wrong.

string.name: settings_permission_required
string.value: This device does not have settings.read. Enable settings access for it in the DSH WebUI workspace settings; editing also requires settings.write.

string.name: settings_subtitle
string.value: Manage connection, model providers, device permissions, and language

string.name: show_context_desc
string.value: Blocks the system pushes in every turn: runtime context, time context, background job notices. Hidden by default — they put a row of collapsed blocks between every message. Turn on when debugging.

string.name: upgrade_notice
string.value: Your previously saved connection was migrated automatically; its address and credential are preserved.

string.name: web_chat_desc
string.value: Off uses the native screen. On renders the chat page with the built-in web view, so Markdown, code blocks and cards look closer to the desktop.

string.name: web_chat_footnote
string.value: Still a trial: streaming was wired up recently, and small differences from the native version remain. Switch it off any time.

string.name: web_chat_footnote_port
string.value: This port renders the chat page natively in ArkUI and ships no web page, so this switch currently has no effect on the UI. It is kept only to stay consistent with the desktop settings.

string.name: command_export_description
string.value: Download this session log as a ZIP file

string.name: command_goal_description
string.value: Set or view the long-running task goal

string.name: command_permission_description
string.value: Switch the permission preset (sandbox and approval policy)

string.name: workspace_files_unavailable
string.value: Can't read this session's working directory
